$comment: Trailing spoken instructions, schema v1. A delimiter near the end of a
finalized take splits it into payload (before) and instruction (after).
canonical is the spelling shown in the UI; match_tokens are the token
cores a recognizer may produce (lowercased, attached ,.;:!? ignored);
window_words is how many trailing words the delimiter may sit in.
Rules: the last occurrence in the window wins; a delimiter after the
language's literal word, or with no letter or digit after it, is not
an occurrence; a quoted mention never matches; offsets are Unicode
code points. Semantics: tests/spoken_instructions.py; Rust port:
